notes: VALIDATOR UNIT TEST config. Offline mock pair; no GPU, no pod. Label shuffle is DISABLED on purpose: the planted cards name model_B specifically, so if the shuffle put mock_tic in model_A the true card would become false and the test would measure nothing. Fixing the labels is correct for a unit test and wrong for an agent run, which is why this config is separate and every run made with it is marked cards_injected=true.
